title: Peruvian Shrimp Stir Fry with Smoky Camarones
description: A keto stir fry dish made with succulent shrimp, smoky camarones, and Peruvian-inspired flavors.
instructions: Heat the chicken fat in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add the shrimp and cook for 2-3 minutes per side, until pink and cooked through.
Remove the shrimp from the skillet and set aside.
Add the smoky camarones and jagged to the skillet and cook for 1-2 minutes, until fragrant.
Add the Peruvian seasoning blend and cook for 1 minute, until fragrant.
Add the chupe de camarones to the skillet and bring to a simmer.
Return the shrimp to the skillet and cook for 1-2 minutes, until heated through.
Serve immediately, garnished with chopped fresh cilantro if desired.
